task.title: Trace key resolution and processing boundaries affecting Insert Keyword pop-ups
task.shortdesc: Identify where key resolution occurs in the authoring and build pipeline and ensure the topic is processed within the same map context as the key definitions.

step.cmd: {'step': 'Determine how you are invoking Insert Keyword (from within a topic editor session) and ensure the session is associated with an active map that contains the key definitions.'}
{'step': 'Identify whether key resolution is performed by the editor at authoring time, by a background indexer, or only during publishing, and note which stage is failing to see the keys.'}
{'step': 'Check whether the topic is being edited through a branch-filtered view, profiling filter, or conditional processing mode that might exclude the <keydef> from the active context.'}
{'step': 'Verify that any preprocessing step (conref push/pull, mapref expansion, branch filtering) does not remove or relocate <keydef> elements before the editor builds its key index.'}
{'step': 'Rebuild or refresh the tool’s key index/cache for the map set (for example, reindex project/workspace) and confirm Insert Keyword now shows pop-ups for those keys.'}

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
